## AI resources for your research

- [Doing Research with AI Agents](https://iqss.github.io/dss-agentic-research/) — A guide to working with agents throughout a research project, from literature searches and analysis to writing and reproducibility.
- [Extending Your Agent’s Toolkit](https://iqss.github.io/dss-agentic-toolkit/) — Tools that help agents manage research workflows, with guidance on setup and use.
- [DSS Agent Skills](https://iqss.github.io/dss-agent-skills/) — Reusable instructions for recurring tasks, such as setting up projects, searching the literature, and reviewing analyses.
